lessons_used: Predictions remained overly optimistic overall, yet consistently underpredicted the magnitude of major winning tests.

New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), home notifications (home, notification), sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder), and choose path layouts (choose_path, layout) proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen), finish redesigns (finish, redesign), and finish new flows (finish, new_flow) consistently generated negative metrics or guardrail rollbacks.

Finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), home new flows (home, new_flow), sign-in copy changes (sign_in, copy), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently resulted in no clear effect across multiple tests.

Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow/redesign, and sign_in layout/new_flow/redesign), requiring at least 2 agreeing tests to establish a pattern.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Adoption Customization Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive customization flow on the pick friend screen allowing users to preview pet animations, custom colors, and sounds in real time.
candidates.why: New adoption flows drive consistent winning tests per lessons. Adoption step has 92.7% conversion but high median time (89s).

guard.reason: The customization flow retains the core job of letting the user choose a pet while adding interactive previews.

candidates.score_note: New adoption flows are proven winners in lessons; targets 89s median adoption time.

candidates.title: Choose Path Full Bleed Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the choose path step into a full bleed visual layout emphasizing path choices with full-screen visuals.
candidates.why: Choose path layouts proved helpful in lessons. Choose path step has a high mean time of 514s indicating users need clear visual path distinction.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Desktop Companion Path
choose_path.body: Pick a preset desktop friend or create your own custom companion.

guard.reason: The full bleed redesign clearly offers both preset and custom companion path choices as required.

candidates.score_note: Choose path step has 21.5% drop-off; layout changes are highlighted as helpful in lessons.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Adoption Certificate Step
candidates.change: Moves sign-in immediately after the adoption certificate screen so users sign in only after completing pet adoption.
candidates.why: Sign-in reordering proved helpful in lessons. Support emails highlight 8 issues regarding pets missing after signing in.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed and retains all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets sign-in drop-off and 8 support tickets; sign-in reordering is a proven winning strategy.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Audio Launch Alert
candidates.change: Adds an audio launch alert badge and notification trigger on the waiting screen when background companion setup completes.
candidates.why: Home notifications proved helpful in lessons. The waiting/home transition has high median time (201s) and high drop-off.

guard.reason: Adding an audio launch alert to the waiting screen complies with onboarding modification rules.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications consistently perform well to re-engage users during high median wait times (201s).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Interactive Celebration Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive celebration flow with animation and sound effects when confirming the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: New adoption flows drive high engagement according to lessons, strengthening completion intent before entering the waiting screen.

guard.reason: Adding celebration animations and sound effects to the adoption certificate screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Adoption new flows drive consistent winning tests across 12 historical runs.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Protection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen using a spotlight layout with clear account pet-save assurances and cloud status indicators.
candidates.why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing in. Clarifying pet account protection on sign-in addresses top user complaints.

sign_in.headline: Protect Your Pet Profile
sign_in.body: Sign in to securely sync your companion, custom settings, and accessories to the cloud.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen to emphasize cloud backup status preserves its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by 8 support tickets and strong +4.7% single test, but confidence is limited by single test history.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Full Bleed Gallery Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a full bleed gallery showing full-screen animated pet previews.
candidates.why: Adoption redesign is a major move targeting the adoption step, which has high mean time (1017s) during friend selection.

guard.reason: The redesign removes the selection control, so the pick friend screen no longer allows the user to choose a pet.

candidates.title: Choose Path Pet Style Selection Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet style preview screen (`new_style_preview`) before choose path to showcase preset vs custom companion options.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean time of 514s. Adding a visual style preview screen clarifies options before path commitment.

new_style_preview.headline: Discover Companion Styles
new_style_preview.body: Explore preset animated friends or build your own custom desktop companion.

guard.reason: 'change' has markup, a link or characters outside plain ASCII

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Habitat Generation Progress Details
candidates.change: Displays live stage generation updates and estimated time remaining during background asset creation on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home target step has median time 201s and mean 2336s. Detailed progress updates keep users informed while waiting.

waiting.hint: Rendering companion animations and preparing desktop environment...

guard.reason: Showing progress and estimated time during active asset creation represents a real wait and is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median/mean home wait times; home wait info has a steady +0.9% average across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Sign In Cloud Backup Verification Flow
candidates.change: Adds a cloud backup progress flow on the sign-in screen showing active profile sync status upon signing in.
candidates.why: Addresses 8 support tickets about missing pets after sign-in by visually verifying account sync during authentication.

guard.reason: Adding a cloud sync verification indicator on the sign-in screen is a valid flow change within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Matches support tickets well, but sign-in new flow lost -2.9% in its single previous test.
